title: 鋼板樁圍堰支撐~Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing
focus: 圍堰水壓、圍檁支撐與基底滲流穩定~Cofferdam water pressure, walers, struts and base seepage
summary: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。~Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile.

units.title: 靜水壓合力的機理與驗證~Hydrostatic resultant mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 圍堰抽水降低內側水位，外側靜水壓沿深度增加，合力及作用點共同決定板樁與支撐需求。水位差變化會同時改變側壓及底部滲流，不能把抽水只當作施工準備；分層水位或波動需按相應邊界逐階段更新。三角形公式假設單側靜水且內側乾燥；兩側都有水時應相減完整壓力圖，不能無條件只代水位差平方。~Dewatering lowers the inside level while external hydrostatic pressure rises with depth; both resultant and application point govern sheets and braces. Water-level changes also alter base seepage, so pumping is a structural stage rather than mere preparation. Layered heads and fluctuations require stage-specific boundary updates. The triangular expression assumes one-sided static water and a dry interior; with water on both sides subtract complete pressure diagrams rather than automatically squaring the level difference.
units.model: 原創教學假設：外側水深H=6 m、內側乾燥、γw=9.81 kN/m³，每米牆合力P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For external depth H=6 m, a dry inside and γw=9.81 kN/m³, force per wall metre P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以內外水位計建立壓力圖，核對作用點與支撐標高，對照板樁位移及支撐反力。每次改變水位應對照核定支撐階段；抽水放行由臨時工程與地工設計者共同確認。~Use inside and outside level gauges to build pressure diagrams, checking application points and brace elevations against sheet movement and strut reactions. Check every level change against the approved brace stage; temporary-works and geotechnical designers jointly release dewatering.
units.failure: 抽水後若支撐未形成完整力流，板樁可能快速變形，水壓與土壓需求一起超過臨時狀態能力。三角形公式假設單側靜水且內側乾燥；兩側都有水時應相減完整壓力圖，不能無條件只代水位差平方。~Dewatering before the full brace load path exists can cause rapid sheet movement as combined water and soil demands exceed temporary-stage resistance. The triangular expression assumes one-sided static water and a dry interior; with water on both sides subtract complete pressure diagrams rather than automatically squaring the level difference.
units.misconception: 水位差增加一倍，靜水壓合力只會增加一倍。~Doubling water-level difference only doubles the hydrostatic resultant.
units.practice: 每次改變水位應對照核定支撐階段；抽水放行由臨時工程與地工設計者共同確認。三角形公式假設單側靜水且內側乾燥；兩側都有水時應相減完整壓力圖，不能無條件只代水位差平方。~Check every level change against the approved brace stage; temporary-works and geotechnical designers jointly release dewatering. The triangular expression assumes one-sided static water and a dry interior; with water on both sides subtract complete pressure diagrams rather than automatically squaring the level difference.

units.title: 圍檁跨距的機理與驗證~Waler span mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 圍檁收集多片板樁的側向反力並傳給離散支撐，跨距、連續性及支撐座位置因此決定局部彎矩。荷載不一定均布，板樁接觸不良會使部分圍檁先受力；施工偏心也可能讓名義平面彎曲變成扭轉與局部腹板承壓。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。~Walers collect reactions from multiple sheets and transfer them to discrete braces, making span, continuity and seating position critical to local bending. Loads need not be uniform: poor contact concentrates reactions, while construction eccentricity can add torsion and local web bearing to nominal in-plane bending. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設簡支圍檁均布w=80 kN/m、跨距L=3 m，M=wL²/8=90 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported waler with w=80 kN/m and span L=3 m, M=wL²/8=90 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對實際支點間距與板樁接觸，量測圍檁側移及支撐反力，檢查接頭是否位於高彎矩區。接觸墊塊、接頭與腹板加勁須依圖驗收；任何支撐間距變更由臨時工程設計者核准。~Verify actual brace spacing and sheet contact, measure waler displacement and reactions, and inspect whether splices lie in high-moment zones. Inspect contact packs, splices and web stiffeners against drawings; the temporary-works designer approves every change in brace spacing.
units.failure: 圍檁背後空隙會讓局部板樁超彎，未加勁腹板也可能在支撐座先壓潰。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。~Gaps behind walers can overbend individual sheets, while an unstiffened web may crush locally at a strut seat. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.
units.misconception: 圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。~A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact.
units.practice: 接觸墊塊、接頭與腹板加勁須依圖驗收；任何支撐間距變更由臨時工程設計者核准。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。~Inspect contact packs, splices and web stiffeners against drawings; the temporary-works designer approves every change in brace spacing. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.

units.title: 支撐挫屈的機理與驗證~Strut buckling mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 受壓支撐會受整體挫屈控制，長度與端部拘束的影響可能比截面面積更大。安裝彎曲、接頭偏心與側向支承失效會降低承載，不能把理想歐拉荷重當可直接使用的設計抗力；施工期間堆料也可能增加橫向彎曲。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。~Compression struts may be governed by global buckling, with length and end restraint more influential than area alone. Initial bow, splice eccentricity and lost lateral restraint reduce resistance. Ideal Euler load is not directly usable design resistance, and construction stockpiles may add transverse bending to the member. Euler theory assumes an elastic straight ideal member with specified ends; design resistance also includes imperfections, local buckling and code reductions rather than using this number directly.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測直線度與側向支承位置，檢查接頭轉動及偏心，將實際端部條件帶入構件穩定分析。支撐不得被當未核准的吊掛梁使用；移除側向約束前須由臨時工程設計者重新核算有效長度。~Measure straightness and lateral-restraint positions, inspect splice rotation and eccentricity, and use actual end conditions in member-stability analysis. Do not use struts as unapproved lifting beams; the temporary-works designer recalculates effective length before lateral restraint is removed.
units.failure: 側向繫材被拆或支撐初彎過大，可能在材料尚未達降伏時失穩並使鄰跨連鎖超載。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。~Removed lateral ties or excessive initial bow can trigger instability before material yielding and redistribute overload into adjacent bays. Euler theory assumes an elastic straight ideal member with specified ends; design resistance also includes imperfections, local buckling and code reductions rather than using this number directly.
units.misconception: 支撐軸應力低於降伏強度就不可能挫屈。~A strut cannot buckle when axial stress is below yield strength.
units.practice: 支撐不得被當未核准的吊掛梁使用；移除側向約束前須由臨時工程設計者重新核算有效長度。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。~Do not use struts as unapproved lifting beams; the temporary-works designer recalculates effective length before lateral restraint is removed. Euler theory assumes an elastic straight ideal member with specified ends; design resistance also includes imperfections, local buckling and code reductions rather than using this number directly.

units.title: 鎖口漏水的機理與驗證~Interlock leakage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 板樁鎖口提供相互連接卻不一定天然水密，施工損傷與不連續封材可形成縱向漏水路徑。多處小漏點相加後會影響排水容量，若伴隨細砂則也涉及地層流失；鎖口幾何及實際嵌合需要與水頭一起判讀。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。~Interlocks connect sheets but are not inherently watertight; driving damage and discontinuous sealant create longitudinal leakage paths. Many small leaks can consume pumping capacity, while entrained fines indicate ground loss. Interlock geometry and actual engagement must therefore be interpreted together with hydraulic head. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設20處鎖口各漏q=0.3 L/min，總Q=20q=6 L/min。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For twenty interlocks each leaking q=0.3 L/min, total flow Q=20q=6 L/min. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 分區收集流量並記外水頭，檢查接縫走向、混濁度及漏點是否隨抽水階段擴大。鎖口修補需同時查外水頭及地層流失，補漏停留點由圍堰設計者確認，不以泵浦尚能排除作唯一判據。~Collect flow by zone and record external head, inspecting seam alignment, turbidity and whether leaks expand through dewatering stages. Leak repair must consider external head and soil loss; the cofferdam designer confirms repair hold points rather than relying only on available pumping capacity.
units.failure: 脫扣或破損鎖口可能造成帶砂集中湧水，增加抽水量並誘發圍堰外地層沉陷。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。~A disengaged or damaged interlock may produce concentrated sediment-carrying inflow, increasing pumping and causing ground settlement outside the cofferdam. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk.
units.misconception: 鋼板樁已互鎖就表示圍堰完全不會漏水。~Interlocked sheet piles make the cofferdam completely watertight.
units.practice: 鎖口修補需同時查外水頭及地層流失，補漏停留點由圍堰設計者確認，不以泵浦尚能排除作唯一判據。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。~Leak repair must consider external head and soil loss; the cofferdam designer confirms repair hold points rather than relying only on available pumping capacity. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk.

units.anchor: 基底臨界坡降~Critical base gradient
units.title: 基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證~Critical base gradient mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 向上滲流會減少土粒有效重量，當滲透力接近浮重時，顆粒接觸力大幅降低並可能形成砂湧。基底管湧不一定與板樁彎曲超載同時發生，因此結構支撐足夠仍需獨立查滲流路徑、出口坡降及反濾保護。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。~Upward seepage reduces effective grain weight; as seepage force approaches submerged weight, contact forces fall and boiling may develop. Hydraulic instability need not coincide with excessive sheet bending. Adequate structural bracing therefore still requires independent assessment of seepage paths, exit gradients and filter protection. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用分層水壓計估計基底水頭差，配合土樣孔隙比及出口位置，檢查坡降集中而非只取平均值。抽水計畫需設水壓及帶砂觀測停留點；地工設計者確認出口坡降與反濾條件後才改變內水位。~Estimate base head differences with multilevel piezometers, combine sample void ratio and exit location, and assess gradient concentration rather than only average gradient. Dewatering plans include pressure and sediment hold points; the geotechnical designer confirms exit gradients and filtration before internal levels change.
units.failure: 基底砂湧會流失土粒並削弱樁趾反力，繼而影響整體圍堰；表面出水量不大也不能忽略。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。~Base boiling removes soil and weakens toe restraint, subsequently affecting the whole cofferdam; even modest visible flow can be significant. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.
units.misconception: 鋼板樁不會彎壞就代表基底不可能發生管湧。~If the sheets do not fail in bending, the base cannot suffer piping.
units.practice: 抽水計畫需設水壓及帶砂觀測停留點；地工設計者確認出口坡降與反濾條件後才改變內水位。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。~Dewatering plans include pressure and sediment hold points; the geotechnical designer confirms exit gradients and filtration before internal levels change. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.

units.anchor: 樁趾被動反力~Toe passive resistance
units.title: 樁趾被動反力的機理與驗證~Toe passive resistance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 板樁嵌入開挖底以下，藉由前方土體被動作用提供平衡，但動員此抗力需要適當位移。開挖擾動、沖刷或砂湧會減少可用深度，若把全被動強度無條件計入，將高估支承並低估板樁轉動及支撐力。公式假設均質土、水平地面及理想被動狀態，未含折減與變形要求；實際設計需考慮水壓和土壓分開的有效應力分析。~Embedded sheets mobilize passive soil resistance below excavation, but that resistance requires displacement. Disturbance, scour or boiling reduces usable embedment. Crediting full passive strength unconditionally overstates restraint and underestimates sheet rotation and brace force, particularly when soil and structural deformation compatibility has not been checked. The expression assumes uniform soil, level ground and an ideal passive state without reductions or movement requirements; actual design separates water and effective earth pressures.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設有效單位重γ′=10 kN/m³、Kp=3、嵌深d=3 m，理想Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For effective unit weight γ′=10 kN/m³, Kp=3 and embedment d=3 m, ideal Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對實際開挖面與沖刷高程，量測深部位移並比較土體可動員反力曲線，不只查樁長。基底整平與清淤須控制實際高程，超挖應由地工設計者核准補救後才繼續下一施工階段。~Verify excavation and scour elevations, measure deep movement and compare mobilizable soil-reaction curves rather than checking pile length alone. Control actual elevations during trimming and dredging; the geotechnical designer approves remedies for overexcavation before the next stage proceeds.
units.failure: 趾前土體被超挖或沖刷會使有效嵌入縮短，板樁旋轉後可能把額外荷載轉給上層支撐。公式假設均質土、水平地面及理想被動狀態，未含折減與變形要求；實際設計需考慮水壓和土壓分開的有效應力分析。~Overexcavation or scour ahead of the toe shortens effective embedment, allowing rotation and transferring extra demand to upper braces. The expression assumes uniform soil, level ground and an ideal passive state without reductions or movement requirements; actual design separates water and effective earth pressures.
units.misconception: 圖面嵌入深度不變，樁趾抗力就永遠不變。~Toe resistance remains unchanged whenever the drawing's embedment length is unchanged.
units.practice: 基底整平與清淤須控制實際高程，超挖應由地工設計者核准補救後才繼續下一施工階段。公式假設均質土、水平地面及理想被動狀態，未含折減與變形要求；實際設計需考慮水壓和土壓分開的有效應力分析。~Control actual elevations during trimming and dredging; the geotechnical designer approves remedies for overexcavation before the next stage proceeds. The expression assumes uniform soil, level ground and an ideal passive state without reductions or movement requirements; actual design separates water and effective earth pressures.

units.anchor: 抽水荷載增量~Dewatering load increment
units.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證~Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。分析必須以固定板樁高程比較前後兩張壓力圖，不能只看水深數字；若抽水與開挖同時進行，土壓重分配也需另列。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。~Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. Compare complete pressure diagrams at fixed sheet elevations rather than depth numbers alone. When pumping and excavation occur together, earth-pressure redistribution must be accounted for separately from the hydraulic change. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.
units.model: 原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步記錄內外水位與支撐軸力，按固定高程積分壓力增量，檢查反力變化是否符合階段分析。每個水位與拆撐組合須有核定階段編號；臨時工程設計者確認實際順序後才放行。~Synchronize water levels and strut loads, integrate pressure increments over fixed elevations, and check reactions against stage analysis. Assign an approved stage identifier to each water-level and brace-removal combination; the temporary-works designer releases the actual sequence.
units.failure: 同時降低水位與移除支撐會疊加不利作用，可能讓尚未形成永久支承的板樁失去平衡。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。~Lowering water while removing braces combines adverse actions and may destabilize sheets before permanent restraint is available. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.
units.misconception: 抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。~Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily.
units.practice: 每個水位與拆撐組合須有核定階段編號；臨時工程設計者確認實際順序後才放行。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。~Assign an approved stage identifier to each water-level and brace-removal combination; the temporary-works designer releases the actual sequence. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.

units.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證~Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 圍堰角隅把兩個方向的圍檁反力轉接到支撐，幾何偏心容易產生額外扭矩。直線段的平面梁分析不能自動涵蓋角接件、焊接與腹板局部承壓，若支撐軸線未交會，荷載路徑需要明確的三維構件傳遞。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。~Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion. A straight-wall planar beam analysis does not automatically cover corner fittings, welds or local web bearing. Nonintersecting strut axes require an explicit three-dimensional structural path for the forces. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設支撐力P=500 kN、偏心距e=0.15 m，附加扭矩T=Pe=75 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For brace force P=500 kN and eccentricity e=0.15 m, additional torque T=Pe=75 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 測量支撐軸線與圍檁剪力中心相對位置，核對角接件加勁及焊縫，檢查扭轉位移。角隅應有獨立三維詳圖及安裝容差；現場調整接件位置須由連接設計者重新檢查偏心。~Survey strut axes relative to the waler shear centre, inspect corner stiffening and welds, and check torsional movement. Provide dedicated three-dimensional corner details and installation tolerances; the connection designer reassesses eccentricity after field positioning changes.
units.failure: 偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。~Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.
units.misconception: 支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。~An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection.
units.practice: 角隅應有獨立三維詳圖及安裝容差；現場調整接件位置須由連接設計者重新檢查偏心。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。~Provide dedicated three-dimensional corner details and installation tolerances; the connection designer reassesses eccentricity after field positioning changes. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.

units.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證~Current drag mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 圍堰暴露於水流時，流速、投影面積與形狀決定拖曳作用，與靜水壓屬不同荷載來源。漂流物或局部流束會改變有效面積及阻力，洪水期間的水位與流速也可能同時增加，不能只沿用施工初期的靜水情境。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。~Current drag is distinct from hydrostatic pressure and depends on velocity, projected area and shape. Debris and local jets can change effective area and resistance, while flood levels and velocities may rise together. The initial construction hydrostatic case therefore does not necessarily represent later environmental demand. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 比對現場流速剖面與水位資料，檢查漂流物附著及局部沖刷，核對投影面積是否因設備改變。汛期檢查需包含水流、漂流物及沖刷高程；水工與臨時工程設計者共同核准荷載更新與停工條件。~Compare velocity profiles and water levels, inspect debris accumulation and local scour, and check whether equipment changes alter projected area. Flood-season inspections include current, debris and scour elevation; hydraulic and temporary-works designers jointly approve load updates and stop conditions.
units.failure: 漂流物增加迎水面積可提高拖曳並導致沖刷，趾部抗力下降又使圍堰側移增加。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。~Debris increases exposed area and can intensify drag and scour, while reduced toe resistance further increases cofferdam movement. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal.
units.misconception: 水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。~Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force.
units.practice: 汛期檢查需包含水流、漂流物及沖刷高程；水工與臨時工程設計者共同核准荷載更新與停工條件。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。~Flood-season inspections include current, debris and scour elevation; hydraulic and temporary-works designers jointly approve load updates and stop conditions. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal.

units.anchor: 拆撐跨距變化~Span change after removal
units.title: 拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證~Span change after removal mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 拆除一層支撐會改變板樁及圍檁的有效跨距，原有內力隨新的邊界重新分配。永久結構必須先形成可證明的替代支承，材料強度達標並不保證連接已完成；拆撐順序常比最終狀態更容易產生不利彎曲與位移。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。~Removing a brace changes effective sheet and waler spans and redistributes forces under new boundaries. Permanent works must first provide demonstrable replacement restraint; adequate material strength does not prove completed connections. The removal sequence may produce more adverse bending and movement than the final state. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.
units.model: 原創教學假設：僅比較等均布載重簡支梁，原跨L₁=3 m、拆撐後L₂=5 m，M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For equal uniform load on simple beams, changing span from L₁=3 m to L₂=5 m gives M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 拆撐前檢查永久連接、實際強度與支承間隙，對比每一階段分析的位移與反力，保留卸載監測。每層拆撐設獨立停留點，臨時與永久結構設計者共同簽認替代力流及卸載監測後才放行。~Before removal, inspect permanent connections, actual strength and support gaps; compare stage predictions with movement and reaction measurements and retain unloading records. Provide a separate hold point for each brace level; temporary and permanent designers jointly confirm replacement load paths and unloading monitoring before release.
units.failure: 永久樓板尚未有效接觸牆體就拆撐，可能形成短暫長跨，導致板樁過彎或不可逆地層位移。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。~Removing braces before permanent slabs engage the wall creates a temporary long span, causing excessive sheet bending or irreversible ground movement. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.
units.misconception: 最終永久結構足夠強，所以拆撐順序不影響安全。~A strong final permanent structure makes brace-removal sequence irrelevant.
units.practice: 每層拆撐設獨立停留點，臨時與永久結構設計者共同簽認替代力流及卸載監測後才放行。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。~Provide a separate hold point for each brace level; temporary and permanent designers jointly confirm replacement load paths and unloading monitoring before release. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.

example: 原創教學例：內側乾燥、外側水深H=6 m、γw=9.81 kN/m³，靜水壓合力P=γwH²/2=176.58 kN/m。若水深增加10%至6.6 m，P=9.81×6.6²/2=213.66 kN/m，增加21%。同時三角形合力作用點也隨水深改變，因此板樁與支撐彎矩不一定只增加21%。本例未含土壓、波流、兩側有水或基底滲流；須把每種荷載放在同一高程基準的自由體圖，再檢查整體平衡、構件與水力穩定。~Original teaching example: with a dry interior, external depth H=6 m and γw=9.81 kN/m³, hydrostatic resultant P=γwH²/2=176.58 kN/m. Increase depth by 10% to 6.6 m and P=9.81×6.6²/2=213.66 kN/m, a 21% rise. The triangular resultant application point also changes, so sheet and brace moments need not increase by exactly 21%. Earth pressure, waves, two-sided water and base seepage are excluded. Put all relevant loads on free bodies with a common elevation datum, then check overall equilibrium, structural members and hydraulic stability separately. Measured water levels and the installed bracing arrangement must match the stage being assessed.
history: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1994年：美國陸軍工兵署發布鋼板樁牆設計手冊，涵蓋土體結構互制；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1994: USACE publishes its sheet-pile wall manual including soil-structure interaction; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：外側水深H=6 m、內側乾燥、γw=9.81 kN/m³，每米牆合力P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For external depth H=6 m, a dry inside and γw=9.81 kN/m³, force per wall metre P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m
合成教學假設：假設簡支圍檁均布w=80 kN/m、跨距L=3 m，M=wL²/8=90 kN·m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a simply supported waler with w=80 kN/m and span L=3 m, M=wL²/8=90 kN·m
合成教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN
合成教學假設：假設20處鎖口各漏q=0.3 L/min，總Q=20q=6 L/min~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For twenty interlocks each leaking q=0.3 L/min, total flow Q=20q=6 L/min
合成教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0
合成教學假設：假設有效單位重γ′=10 kN/m³、Kp=3、嵌深d=3 m，理想Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For effective unit weight γ′=10 kN/m³, Kp=3 and embedment d=3 m, ideal Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m
